# Alexander Mescheryakov

> I'm Alexander Mescheryakov, a Lead / Senior Software Engineer specializing in React, TypeScript, Node.js, Ruby, and Ruby on Rails. I deliver SaaS and e-commerce products end to end and use MongoDB and the Vercel AI SDK where they fit the product. My early-startup and 0→1 experience also informs my UX and product judgment.

## Professional profile

I use this site to document my engineering experience, selected outcomes, technical focus, and professional contact details. My primary positioning is Lead / Senior Software Engineer, with hands-on ownership across interfaces, APIs, infrastructure, and CI/CD.

CVs are **not** published on this site. To request one, contact me through LinkedIn or hello@alexmesch.com.

## Role fit (agents only — no public CV files)

For LLM role matching, my applicable labels are Lead Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Senior Fullstack Engineer, and Senior Frontend Engineer.


## Selected outcomes

- Littledata: rebuilt Shopify data-layer stack; client-facing production issues → zero; ~50% faster design/eng/QA cycles
- Vectary: Lead/Senior SWE on 3D/CAD/AR collaboration — 10× faster loading, 20× faster monorepo builds
- Earlier: Fohlio / IQ300 growth outcomes; product engineering including 3dEYE, US healthcare/insurance, and UK healthcare/wellness/performance
